Definition: a dell or crevice (as if pierced in the earth)
BiblicalUsage: This word is to hide or lurk, and it describes Israel in a strait, hiding in caves and thickets and rocks and high places and pits when the Philistines press them. The whole people goes to ground.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the hiding places of Israel show what fear does to a people, and Saul's unlawful sacrifice grew out of that same fear.
